description: Compute position weights, concentration, annualised volatility and maximum drawdown. When a portfolio snapshot and a return series need a first risk read. Do not choose this when VaR, covariance or factor models are required. Example requests: Give me a risk report for this portfolio. | How concentrated is this portfolio and how volatile? | Compute the drawdown on these returns.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

holdings.description: The customer's holdings.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The portfolio positions. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

returns.description: The customer's returns.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The return series. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
